goal: Generate a poster that can serve as the main image for a consumer electronics brand's single-node communication, featuring both the character and product as dual focal points, with a restrained overall design centered around a single Chinese slogan, achieving an Apple-like minimalist feel without copying any official logos.

brand.name: Innovators · Responsible Technology Annual Forum
brand.industry: Cross-disciplinary forum on technology, public policy, and developer ecosystem (main visuals should not impersonate Apple official release materials).

visual_tone.aesthetic: Extremely minimal futuristic feel + warm soft light portrait.
visual_tone.color_palette: Deep space gray + silver white + very light cyan highlights
visual_tone.lighting: Left front side soft light, facial contrast restrained, with delicate Fresnel highlights on the product edges

centerpiece.description: Tim Cook half-body frontal, smiling naturally, wearing a dark blue round-neck knit and a no-logo dark gray jacket; on his right side, a no-logo silver laptop is floating open, displaying an abstract multi-window interface; the person and the laptop together occupy about half the height of the picture, leaving space at the top and left for the title area.
centerpiece.scale: Character including the computer occupies about 55% of the image.

slogan.main: Take one more step, and you will reach the next scene
slogan.sub: Innovator Annual Meeting · Ecosystem and Responsibility Special Session

logo_placement.position: Small text in the lower right corner combined with geometric symbols
logo_placement.size: Moderate and not stealing the main visual, only occupying about 6% of the screen width.

aspect_ratio: 3:4 vertical version, with 5% safe cutting margin all around

must_keep: Main sentence within eight characters, readable at a glance
Character should be recognizable as a mild and professional public figure, not cartoonish or grotesque.
No recognizable real Apple trademarks, no official endorsement implications
The primary colors in the entire image do not exceed three major blocks
avoid: Stuff Multiple Models in One Image
Behind the character is piled with promotional stickers.
